Name: Digital Process Transformation
Description: Funds the digitalization of operational and administrative processes across business functions: removing manual steps, self-service portals, automation with Power Platform and integration with existing business systems.

Name: Security and Compliance
Description: Funds initiatives that reduce cyber risk and ensure compliance with NIS2, GDPR and internal policies: identity protection, network segmentation, monitoring and incident response.

Name: Data and Artificial Intelligence
Description: Funds data and AI use cases with measurable business value, provided that the data is available, of adequate quality and handled according to responsible AI principles.

Name: Modern Workplace
Description: Funds tools and services that improve the digital employee experience: collaboration, internal communication, intranet, workstations and adoption of Microsoft 365 tools.

Name: Infrastructure and Cloud
Description: Funds the modernization of IT infrastructure: cloud migrations, resilience and business continuity, lower infrastructure costs and less technical debt.
